metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Fix a Lower Backache
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shares simple exercises designed to relieve lower back pain quickly—even in as little as 30 seconds.

These movements target common sources of discomfort, helping reduce pain, stiffness, and tightness by both stretching and strengthening the key muscles that support your lower back.

Each exercise works in a different way, focusing on specific muscle groups and performed in a variety of positions.

For the best results, try them all and stick with the ones that provide the most relief for your back.

Start now and take the first step toward easing your lower back pain at home!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:37 Bed/Floor Exercise
2:45 Seated Exercise
4:51 Standing Exercise
7:04 Strengthening Exercise 1
8:37 Strengthening Exercise 2
